summary: Standing rule: a developer-failed stop whose only failing tests are the known local-only set (sign-attestation, verify-attestation, verify-runtime, bin-invocation, usage-views, usage-ingest, check-rm-guard) with build/lint/format green is env-only; dispatch resumes push-only without escalation, CI ai-sdlc/pr-ready is the gate

options.description: dispatch resumes push-only without escalation when only the listed tests fail locally; CI is the gate
keep escalating each occurrence to the planner

body: Hit by AISDLC-828, 837, 843, 836, 844 on 2026-10-13. Evidence: CI on main f95ef5b8 (#1468) Build & Test (Node 22) and Integration Tests success while the same tests fail locally (AISDLC-814 class: attestation runtime walks node_modules; usage-* timeouts under full load). Five-step: requirement questioned (local green on pre-existing unrelated reds is not a gate; CI is the single gate, AISDLC-726); delete the per-task escalation; simplify to one list; accelerate (push now); automate later via AISDLC-814 and the developer-failed step comparing failing files against origin/main. Escalate only when the PR's CI fails on the same test.
